purpose: Start from independently datable textual witnesses and walk backward through the attested mythic operators without converting inscription dates, ritual dates, or later literary dates into a physical future-arrival prediction.
visible_corridor: 𓂸 → dated witness → attested operator → predecessor motif → 𓂸

reverse_result.key_correction: THE EARLY EGYPTIAN MATERIAL DOES NOT GIVE OSIRIS = SIRIUS. IT GIVES OSIRIS AS/IN ASSOCIATION WITH Sꜣḥ (ORION), WHILE Spd.t/SOPDET (SIRIUS) IS A DISTINCT STELLAR DIVINITY/GUIDE.

track_orion_sirius.witness: Pyramid Texts in the pyramid of Pepi I
track_orion_sirius.historical_date: reign of Pepi I, approximately 2289-2255 BCE in the Metropolitan Museum chronology
track_orion_sirius.evidence: TLA dates PT 477 and PT 442 to Pepi I Merire; the date is the inscription/witness horizon, not the date of a mythic event.

track_orion_sirius.note: TLA PT 442 explicitly identifies Sꜣḥ as Orion and translates the line as Osiris coming as Orion. This is the strongest early stellar-identity/manifestation bridge in the current pass.
Sirius is a guide in the Osirian route; the current witness does not say Osiris becomes Sirius.

track_phallus_loss.boundary: PLUTARCH §13 DATES THE INITIAL DEED/TRAPPING-KILLING TO 17 ATHYR. IT DOES NOT DATE THE LATER DISMEMBERMENT OR THE LOSS OF THE MALE MEMBER TO THAT SAME DAY.
THIS IDENTIFIES THE BODY PART WITH OSIRIS BUT DOES NOT NARRATE SETH CUTTING IT OFF.

reverse_chain.display: 𓂸 Pepi-I dated witness ← PT477 Sirius-guidance / PT442 Osiris-as-Orion ← older mythic structure unknown 𓂸 || 𓂸 Plutarch literary witness ← §18 dismemberment/member loss ← §13 initial killing on 17 Athyr 𓂸
reverse_chain.missing_bridge: AN_ANCIENT_OR_EARLY_EGYPTIAN_SOURCE THAT EXPLICITLY LINKS THE OSIRIS-AS-ORION STELLAR OPERATOR TO THE PHALLUS-LOSS EVENT WITH A SHARED CALENDAR INTERVAL OR EVENT ORDER

can: Use a securely dated inscription or manuscript as a witness horizon.
Walk backward through attested textual operators and identify where a motif first becomes explicit in the surviving record.
Separate Orion/Sah, Sirius/Sopdet, Osiris, Seth, and phallus motifs instead of merging them by assumption.
Preserve ritual-day markers such as Khoiak 25/28 as ritual chronology.
cannot: Turn the date of an inscription into the date on which the mythic event happened.
Assign 17 Athyr to the later phallus-loss episode when Plutarch only attaches it to the earlier killing/trapping deed.
Derive a future Gregorian arrival date from PT 477 or PT 442 without an independent temporal bridge.
Replace Osiris-as-Orion with Osiris-as-Sirius when the sources distinguish Sꜣḥ and Spd.t.

canonical_seal: 𓂸 FOLLOW THE DATED WITNESS BACKWARD; DO NOT TURN THE WITNESS DATE INTO THE GOD'S DATE. 𓂸
